description_en: Returns media asset information that matches the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 根据用户所提供参数，返回符合条件的媒资信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-media --match Title_=_China_and_utcCreate_=_1693367158561_,_1693367158562 --sort-by utcCreate:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --entity-id 2d3bf1e35a1e42b5ab338d701efa0000 --scroll-token F8C4F642184DBDA5D93907A70AAE0000 --search-lib-name test-1 --custom-filters '{"intField1":{"gte":12,"lte":13},"strField2":["cd","de"],"strField1":"abc"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMedia

parameters.help_en: The filter condition. <props="china">For syntax rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584256.html.</props>
parameters.name: match

parameters.help_en: The sort fields and sort orders, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段和排序顺序。多个使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. This is a 32-character field. You do not need to set this parameter for the first search request. When the search request matches data, the server returns this parameter value to record the current position of the search data. Record the returned parameter value and set this parameter in the next search request according to the following requirements or suggestions: This parameter must be set when you need to traverse all data that matches the search conditions. When the PageNo parameter value exceeds 200, set this parameter to optimize search performance. You can only page forward, and the maximum paging distance is 1000 media assets
parameters.help_zh: 翻页标识。32字段。第一次执行搜索请求时不用设置本参数。搜索请求命中数据时，服务端会返回该参数值，用于记录当前搜索数据的位置地址。请记录返回的参数值，下一次搜索时按下述要求或建议设置本参数：需要遍历搜索条件命中的所有数据时，本参数必须设置。当PageNo参数取值超过200时，建议设置本参数优化搜索性能。只能向后翻页，最大翻页距离为1000媒资
parameters.name: scroll_token

parameters.help_en: The custom filter. This is a JSON string. Supported fields include integer field intField1 and string fields strField1 and strField2. Each field supports only one matching type. Filters on different fields are combined with an AND relationship
parameters.name: custom_filters
